assets.caption_title: Ca sử dụng LMS theo vai trò
assets.semantic_review: Compared the three actors and nine grouped interactions with the role and permission matrix. Lecturer ownership and ACTIVE student enrollment are stated in adjacent prose; common login and notifications are explicitly omitted.
assets.notation_review: Stick figures denote actors, ovals denote interactions and arrowless lines denote participation. Dashed frames group roles and are explicitly not system boundaries. This is a compact use-case view rather than a complete include/extend model.

model_decisions.reason: The course project must explain stored entities, relationships and integrity constraints; the report includes the supplied 12-table ERD.
model_decisions.authority: Supplied guide; database/01_schema.sql; Chapter 9 design scope

assets.semantic_review: Checked the 12 named tables, principal PK/FK links, unique enrollment and submission pairs, and the source-type/source-id grade reference. The original manifest and adjacent prose disclose simplified links; the SQL schema remains the detailed authority.
assets.notation_review: PK/FK labels and relationship lines describe SQL data relationships. GradedBy and some User links are simplified; SourceId is not represented as a fabricated SQL foreign key. Read with the SQL schema and the conceptual class explanation.

model_decisions.reason: The guide requests a class view. A focused conceptual model clarifies the assignment workflow without inventing implementation methods or duplicating every ERD table.
model_decisions.authority: Supplied guide; database/01_schema.sql; assignments route implementation

assets.caption_title: Mô hình lớp khái niệm của luồng bài tập
assets.semantic_review: Verified six concepts and displayed fields against Users, Enrollments, Courses, Assignments, Submissions and Grades. The conceptual view is labelled as a subset, contains no invented methods, and explains the unique assignment/student submission and polymorphic grade source.
assets.notation_review: Rectangular class compartments show names and selected attributes. Solid associations are selected relationships without displayed multiplicities; the ERD supplies the detailed data view. The dashed dependency labelled logic is explicitly not a physical Assignment-to-Grade FK.

model_decisions.reason: The guide requests an activity/process view; the student submission flow exposes acceptance and rejection conditions that matter to scope and testing.
model_decisions.authority: Supplied guide; UC-05; PUT assignment submission implementation

assets.caption_title: Luồng sinh viên nộp bài văn bản
assets.semantic_review: Checked enrollment, deadline/AllowLate, nonempty ContentText, published assignment and active course guards, create/update behavior and the prohibition on changing graded submissions. The figure groups these guards; prose names the omitted detail and text-only MVP.
assets.notation_review: The supplied asset uses flowchart start/end ovals, activities and a Yes/No decision. The document explicitly calls this a simplified activity flow, not a claim of complete UML activity notation. Branches converge to end; rejection does not create a submission.

model_decisions.reason: The guide requests an interaction sequence. Grading connects UI, authorization, transaction changes and the evidence needed before Done.
model_decisions.authority: Supplied guide; backend/app/api/routes/assignments.py get_assignment_submissions and grade_submission

assets.caption_title: Trình tự tương tác khi giảng viên chấm bài
assets.semantic_review: Verified GET /assignments/{assignment_id}/submissions and PUT /submissions/{submission_id}/grade, course-owner validation, score bounds, Submission/Grade updates, Notification creation and commit confirmation. It models the successful path, not an observed execution trace.
assets.notation_review: Participant headers and vertical lifelines identify roles/components; messages run downward in time and arrow direction identifies sender/receiver. Activation and distinct dashed return notation are deliberately omitted and disclosed. Step 9 means successful commit acknowledgement; denial and transaction-error paths are outside the figure.

model_decisions.reason: The guide requests a state view; submission status affects permitted student and lecturer actions and acceptance checks.
model_decisions.authority: Supplied guide; SQL status CHECK constraint; submission/grading endpoints

assets.caption_title: Trạng thái nộp và chấm bài
assets.semantic_review: Checked SUBMITTED, LATE and GRADED against schema and code. The model shows initial acceptance and first grading. Adjacent prose explicitly preserves allowed resubmission before grading and lecturer regrading; the end label does not mean deletion or immutability.
assets.notation_review: Named rounded state boxes and directed transitions show a simplified first-cycle state view. Initial/final ovals and omitted update loops are acknowledged; this is not an exhaustive formal UML state machine.

model_decisions.reason: Architecture boundaries are relevant to the design gate, work packages and technical risk allocation.
model_decisions.authority: LMS docs/03_ARCHITECTURE.md; supplied architecture diagram; project-management design gate

assets.semantic_review: Compared React/TypeScript/Vite, FastAPI/SQLAlchemy and SQL Server boundaries with the source architecture document. The three user roles enter via the frontend; the report keeps authorization at the API and makes no production deployment claim.
assets.notation_review: Boxes and connecting arrows form an architectural component view at system level, not a full UML component/interface specification. Technology labels describe source architecture; they do not identify measured physical hosts or live network topology.

section_reviews.heading: MỞ ĐẦU
section_reviews.argument: Connects fragmented learning information to the need for a controlled project plan and traceable deliverables.
section_reviews.evidence: The method now names source/schema reconciliation and removes the stale claim that the report still uses a generic profile.
section_reviews.terminology: Project assumptions are distinguished from measured user scale and actual approvals.
section_reviews.sufficiency: Explains purpose, method and scope without inventing identity or implementation outcomes.
section_reviews.reviewer: Codex source and editorial review

section_reviews.heading: CHƯƠNG 1. TỔNG QUAN VÀ KHỞI TẠO DỰ ÁN
section_reviews.argument: Relates the business case to LMS core deliverables and explicitly bounded extensions.
section_reviews.evidence: Charter and reconciliation support the 20-week, 1.2-billion-VND and 8.5-FTE planning baseline.
section_reviews.terminology: FTE denotes allocated effort rather than a fixed headcount; business case and acceptance remain planning concepts.
section_reviews.sufficiency: Covers initiation, assumptions and constraints for the authorized essay; sponsor approval is not asserted.
section_reviews.reviewer: Codex source and editorial review

section_reviews.heading: CHƯƠNG 2. CÁC BÊN LIÊN QUAN VÀ TỔ CHỨC DỰ ÁN
section_reviews.argument: Uses stakeholder influence/interest to identify participation and escalation responsibilities.
section_reviews.evidence: The reduced RACI now selects source activities separately: drafting, specification, technical work, sign-off and handover. Each of its eight rows contains one A.
section_reviews.terminology: Responsible and Accountable remain distinct; Dev/QA is an explicitly combined technical column and Sponsor is a planning role.
section_reviews.sufficiency: Resolves the earlier double-A aggregation error and preserves source authority; it does not imply named people have approved the plan.
section_reviews.reviewer: Codex source and editorial review
